output.question: Who owns Xfinity?
output.answer: Xfinity is owned and operated as a business/brand of Comcast Corporation. Comcast’s official website lists Xfinity under “Comcast’s Businesses” and says that Comcast delivers broadband, mobile, and entertainment services through Xfinity. [https://corporate.comcast.com/privacy-related-businesses](https://corporate.comcast.com/privacy-related-businesses) [https://corporate.comcast.com/company/connectivity-platforms](https://corporate.comcast.com/company/connectivity-platforms)

key_facts.fact: Comcast’s official corporate site lists Xfinity under the heading “Comcast’s Businesses.”
Comcast’s official connectivity page states that services are delivered “Through Xfinity, Comcast Business, and Sky.”

passages.quote: Through Xfinity, Comcast Business, and Sky, we deliver world-class broadband, mobile, and entertainment delighting customers with experiences and technology that powers the future.

caveats: The official pages identify Xfinity as a Comcast business/brand; they do not provide a separate legal-entity ownership percentage or a shareholder breakdown for Xfinity itself.
